Shell.Tools.Picture.Name: Picture tools
Shell.Tools.Picture.About: Upscale pictures, clean up softness, noise and JPEG blocks, and repair the faces in them — in the image editor, or when you ask the assistant. Real-ESRGAN and GFPGAN.
Shell.Tools.Selection.Name: Picture selection
Shell.Tools.Selection.About: Pick things out of pictures — click them, draw a box round them, or name them — and cut them out of their background, in the image viewer and editor or when you ask the assistant. SAM 3.1.
Shell.Tools.Reading.Name: Page reading
Shell.Tools.Reading.About: Read pages of writing — scans, photographed pages, scanned PDFs — into Markdown: columns as one text, formulas as LaTeX, tables, and figures, in the image and PDF viewers or when you ask the assistant. Unlimited-OCR and PP-OCRv5.

Shell.Tools.Checking.Name: Picture safety check
Shell.Tools.Checking.About: While Enhanced AI Protection Mode is on, every picture made is checked before it is saved or shown, and one unfit for a general audience is withheld. Fetched the first time a picture is made; runs on the CPU in a few milliseconds. OwenElliott's image safety classifier.
Shell.Tools.Erasing.About: Rub scratches, dust, wires, people or signs out of photos and fill where they were from what is round them, in the image editor or when you ask the assistant about a picture you have open. LaMa.

Shell.Wizard.WhatsNew.Title: What's New
Shell.Wizard.Recovered.NotesFormat:
## Some settings could not be read

Nexaflow could not read {0} this time, so those settings are back at their defaults. Each damaged file has been kept beside its folder under `%APPDATA%\Smile\nexaflow`, and the details are in the crash log, so nothing has been thrown away.

Your workspaces' own data — conversations, notes, ribbon layouts and provider settings — lives in its own folder per workspace and was not affected. A workspace whose entry was lost has been rebuilt from that folder, so it is back with its contents intact; its symbol and colour were stored in the file that was lost, so those have been picked afresh.

The remaining steps let you confirm what replaced the settings that were lost. You can skip them and set everything up later in Options.
